Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `datetime` field (AR-7), via the Set Filter wire shape (`{filterType:'set', values:[...]}`), each wire string coerced once into the field's declared type (SEM-5); SEM-2: `in` never matches null. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"created_at" = ANY($1::timestamptz[])`, because `timestamptz = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). The set values are sent as ISO-8601 instants with a `Z` offset, which SEM-5 coerces into `datetimeValue` (a set filter's `values` take the ISO instant form, not the zone-less `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` form of AG Grid date conditions); the seed rows sit at `.000Z` and `.001Z` around each member to prove millisecond precision.
